entry_route.value: Applicants can enter on the BS-entry or the MS-entry track, with a bachelor's in mathematics or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree in mathematics or in a closely related field.

also.quote: Doctor of Philosophy in Mathematics (General Math, MS Entry)

gre_general.value: Needed for unconditional admission: at least 143 Verbal and 155 Quantitative on the post-2011 test.
gre_general.quote: Minimum of 143 on the verbal and 155 on the quantitative portions of the GRE if taken after August 2011.

funding.value: Scholarships and fellowships are awarded on the same criteria as admission, to eligible admitted students.
funding.quote: Students who are unconditionally admitted or admitted on probation will be eligible for available scholarship and/or fellowship support.

supervisor.value: The page gives no rule on a supervisor before admission.

deadline.value: The page gives no application deadline.

notes: One record for the Mathematics PhD. The General Statistics (statistics) and Data Science (datasci) tracks carry the same GRE and funding wording. The math page asks non-native speakers for TOEFL 550 paper, 213 computer-based, 79 iBT or TSE 40 without naming India; the catalog exemption is used for the university record, so confirm with the department.
